release_notes:
Fix admin menu/labels lagging one reload behind the language switch

The admin menu is built by formsmgmt.php (via gf_menu_tr, which reads
$_SESSION['LANGUAGE_BE'] at build time), but that ran BEFORE switchlanguage.php
applied the ?ln= parameter to the session. So on a language switch the menu was
rendered in the previous language while the dropdown already showed the new one —
you had to reload once more for the menu/labels to catch up.

Now the ?ln= parameter is applied to the session immediately, before formsmgmt.php
builds the menu, so the menu and labels reflect the selected language on the same
request. Verified by simulating the request sequence: "Manage Clients" now renders as
"Gestionar clientes" on the switch request instead of staying English.

(The customer panel was already correct — switchlanguage_nw.php runs before the theme
menu renders, so its labels switch on the same request.)
